instruction: Classify the overall sentiment of the text.

labels.label: positive
labels.definition: the writer is pleased, satisfied or enthusiastic overall

labels.label: negative
labels.definition: the writer is unhappy, frustrated or critical overall, including sarcasm that means the opposite of the literal words

labels.label: neutral
labels.definition: factual statements or questions with no clear feeling either way
